card.fact_statement: The SPD and CDU/CSU parliamentary groups reached a coalition agreement on 9 April.
card.source_span: On 9 April, both SPD and the CDU/CSU parliamentary groups had reached a coalition agreement to form a new cabinet under Friedrich Merz’s chancellorship.
